summary: Tested Order Progress timeline dynamic payment milestone positioning. All features working correctly: Net 30 shows payment at end (after delivered), 50/50 shows payment split before production and before delivery, Milestone 30/40/30 shows payments interleaved at correct lifecycle positions. Payment gate enforcement blocks status transitions, admin override bypasses gates. Vendor status update buttons appear based on current order status.
critical_code_review_comments: getStatusFlow() in OrderDetail.jsx correctly generates dynamic timeline based on payment_schedule.milestones

stageInsertBefore mapping correctly positions payment milestones: before_production→in_production, after_production→quality_check, after_inspection→dispatched, after_dispatch→delivered, on_delivery/net_due→completed
Payment step icons correctly show green CheckCircle2 when paid, amber CreditCard when pending
Connector lines between steps show correct active/inactive colors based on isStepActive()
Vendor status update buttons correctly appear based on current order status (not blocked by payment_status=paid check)
STAGE_GATE in routes/orders.py correctly blocks status transitions when milestone unpaid
Admin override with admin_override:true correctly bypasses payment gates
GET /api/orders/{orderId}/payment-schedule correctly returns is_due for milestones even when order passed the stage via admin override

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All Order Progress timeline features working correctly

seed_data_creation: Used existing order order_8d45a1ea88d1. Tested with Net 30, 50/50, and Milestone 30/40/30 schedules. Order restored to milestone 30/40/30 schedule with pending_payment status after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order Progress timeline dynamically adapts based on payment_schedule. Order order_8d45a1ea88d1 has milestone 30/40/30 schedule (30% before_production, 40% after_production, 30% after_inspection). All milestones pending, order status is pending_payment. Payment gate enforcement blocks status transitions until corresponding milestone is paid. Admin can bypass with admin_override:true.
